body.notify: Adds S4 to the current task-checkpoint review epic: incremental user-visible review progress. Backlog only.

addedStory.title: Show incremental progress during background code reviews
addedStory.userValue: Users can see which task is being reviewed and the last observed activity throughout a long review, without additional model calls. This story supplies activity observations for FUTURE-progress-based-review-timeouts; timeout intervention policy remains separate. Backlog only; no implementation authorized.

acceptanceCriteria.then: It shows phase, task ID/name and position, completed/total tasks, review/task elapsed time and timestamp of last observed activity. Phases cover scope preparation, task review, test execution, feedback persistence and CR publication; unavailable activity is explicitly unknown.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A task runs for several minutes
acceptanceCriteria.when: Native CLI events report source reads, tool/test starts or completions, model output or feedback submission
acceptanceCriteria.then: Bounded sanitized progress metadata updates during the task without extra model calls, reasoning text, raw prompts or raw tool output; routine updates are throttled and do not rewrite immutable submitted packets or completed results.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A subprocess is alive but no meaningful activity is observable
acceptanceCriteria.when: A heartbeat is received or elapsed time advances
acceptanceCriteria.then: The display distinguishes process liveness from last meaningful activity and never invents progress percentages, findings or completion. This story does not change timeout/retry policy.

acceptanceCriteria.given: Claude or Codex performs the review
acceptanceCriteria.when: Progress is polled after reconnect or for concurrent independent review IDs
acceptanceCriteria.then: Both providers expose the same normalized behavior; progress is isolated by review ID/attempt/task, stale data is labelled, and reconnect recovers the latest snapshot without restarting review.

acceptanceCriteria.when: A phase changes or 30–60 seconds pass
acceptanceCriteria.then: The controller surfaces a concise update using existing polling, while terminal completion and errors remain visible and authoritative. No additional LLM summary requests are made.

nextAction.description: Approve the HLD amendment (`AMD-e6ddcdcb3d9cf330-1`) and the updated Epic, then run `design.story` for the new Story `s4` to produce its LLD.
